scientific_integrity: Uses published convex-body defect identity and standard polygon geometry with explicit attribution; no claims of independent validation or historical exclusion beyond searched literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact for calibrated nonnegative fixed \(N\)-node planar Cauchy projection rules with \(N\ge2\); angular stability assumes \(N\) distinct positive nodes. Signed or adaptive rules, higher dimensions, and weight stability are not addressed. Infinite statements rest on analytic proofs, with supplementary finite numerical checks.
title: Sharp positive \(N\)-direction Cauchy quadrature and angular rigidity
